sayLines.line: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
Simone is staying at Haven as the camp healer now — tending the sick instead of ranging out.

Deeper knowledge: Purslane. Uses: highest omega-3 of any leafy plant. Good raw in summer heat. (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: succulent crunch, surprisingly rich — eat fresh; medicine: cooling poultice for minor burns.

Deeper knowledge: Burdock. Uses: starchy root vegetable. Dig first-year plants (no flower stalk). (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: first-year roots only — dig deep, peel, cook like carrots; medicine: root tea, traditional blood purifier; fiber: tough stalk fiber for rough cordage.
